simple.meaning: אַשְׁמָן (ʼashmân) is a Hebrew word meaning “a fat field.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H820. ashmannim אַשְׁמַנִּים (elative, Ges §§ 85b , 133a; on נּ see Id. §§ 20a , 93ee) apparently noun [masculine] plural ׳בָּא כַּמֵּתִים Isa 59:10 perhaps: (we are) among the stout (RV lusty ) like dead men , compare Di-Kit; or abstract in (actual) vigour (Buhl) > AV (after JosKi from אָשַׁם Hosea 14:1 'be desolate' ') in desolate places (other conjectures see (Che Hpt Marti).
